title: Constant Assignment Satisfaction Indicator
statement: Let $c$ be a constraint over $mathbb{F}_2$ that requires the sum of the values on its three pairwise-distinct variables to equal its right-hand side $b$. Under the assignment giving every variable the same value $b$, the satisfaction indicator of $c$ is $1$ if the constraint's right-hand side is $b$, and $0$ otherwise.
